name: Argilla
description: Collaboration tool for curating and labeling data to fine-tune and evaluate large language models.

envVars.description: Secret key used to sign authentication tokens
Password for the default admin user
Password for the Argilla Postgres database

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      ARGILLA_ELASTICSEARCH: "http://{{serviceName}}-elasticsearch:9200"
      ARGILLA_DATABASE_URL: "postgresql+asyncpg://argilla:{{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}@{{serviceName}}-postgres:5432/argilla"
      ARGILLA_AUTH_SECRET_KEY: {{env.ARGILLA_AUTH_SECRET_KEY}}
      ARGILLA_DEFAULT_USER_PASSWORD: {{env.ARGILLA_DEFAULT_USER_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/data:/data
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: argilla
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: argilla
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
  {{serviceName}}-elasticsearch:
    image: docker.elastic.co/elasticsearch/elasticsearch:8.15.0
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-elasticsearch
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      discovery.type: single-node
      xpack.security.enabled: false
      ES_JAVA_OPTS: "-Xms512m -Xmx512m"
